title: Use bold layouts

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Use scale and contrast to establish a clear entry point because a message must compete with its surroundings.
strategic_value: Large type against strong color or photography can give Helsinki communications a recognizable graphic presence.
demonstration: This expanded webpage section pairs guidance on clear, graphic layouts with large-text and pull-quote examples on color and photographs.
practical_value: Choose a strong headline or pull quote and test it against a field that gives it contrast.

content_islands.name: Graphic emphasis
content_islands.spec: Introduce large text and strong backgrounds.

content_islands.name: Cover examples
content_islands.spec: Compare bilingual early-education covers on colored fields with photograph-led city publication covers.

content_islands.name: Pull-quote structure
content_islands.spec: Finish with oversized white text on an orange field and its caption about structural emphasis.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source connects large type/background contrast to visual impact and pull quotes to structure.
reference_purposes.Application: The examples demonstrate large text and quotations against color and images.
